decisions.statement: An advisory stage (federation, lattice staleness, symbolic derivation, refutation) may veto a hypothesis or narrow a size inside (0, 1], compounding with ADR 0063/0066's caps, and never enlarges one.

The downward capital authority is the signed CapitalEnvelope alone; it gains a drawdown bound, the CapitalGrant is stated from it rather than sent beside it, and a hedge plan reaches a cell only as a narrowing frame it may refuse.
The six capital-side brains are crate boundaries proven by closure tests and loops the kernel composes, not new binaries; treasury and the survival kernel are extracted first.
The qip-mesh spine is the platform's control fabric for signed downward frames and cell deltas; the event fabric carries outcomes and records; an acceptance scan admits no third cross-process path.

The broker stamps region, partition and the authenticated principal into the batch header; the writer stamps provenance; the cycle's decision id rides the signed policy payload and the reflex outcome so one join walks API, cycle, cell and ledger.

Simulated fills post into an in-settlement subledger and move to cash at T+n when a producer observes the simulated settlement; the simulated venue's position statement is the custody truth the ledger reconciles against.

Reflex packages sign under the existing model-pack class (ADR 0110 decision 1 already names Cognitive Compiler packages), two-person; promotion drafts the signable qip_contracts ModelPack with the kernel pack id as lineage; configuration becomes a fifth artefact class, two-person, verified by the central composition roots before they read configuration.

One admission header (three times, uncertainty, source hash, entitlement) shared by MarketEvent and every SensedRecord; SourceManifest v2 is additive and v1 stays readable; ticks reach the fabric only as bounded per-pass feature digests.

What crosses between centre and reflex lane: a bounded fused-state digest as a policy slot, a reflex forecast contract the node issues itself, episode summaries on the cell report, and one source per fact (learning on the report, telemetry on the scrape).

The hybrid solver router is qip-optimization-engine's compute router: hedge and hypothesis searches submit to it asynchronously, the classical answer is always computed, a hedge result carries an unwind plan, and the next quantum research family is feature-subset selection on the simulated provider.

Fabric clients bootstrap from the broker module's SRV record through an in-tree DNS query in qip-transport, keep the last good answer for a bounded staleness and fall back to configured addresses; the cluster map is a broker request arm.

Cross-cell wash activity is made impossible by giving each venue-instrument book one owning cell through a signed policy slot, with handovers that gap and never overlap, not by a central pre-trade hop.

A forecast is material when it reaches a size, a capital plan, a published record or a promotion, and every material forecast is a qip_contracts Forecast: lattice members, DemandForecast and the return forecast an ApprovedThesis is sized on.

The hosted language-model adapters move from qip-reasoning-engine/src/providers to services/qip-language-providers, linked by qip-deepbrain alone and pinned out of the fast lanes by lane_placement.rs.
A committed issuer registry lets connectors verify detached signatures with ring, and the evidence fabric credits SignatureVerified only from a VerifiedSignature token the verifier constructs.
Research connector polling runs as a scout Cloud Run job in the existing project with its own identity, no trading role, its own proxy routes and immutable records the deep brain only reads.

Agency authority is a typed schedule widen reads, with evidence, rollback and approvers per level; nothing above NarrowReversible is granted, and External and Capital stay refused by ADR 0114 D8 and ADR 0003/0021/0108.

Shadow is a forward window where the candidate is scored and provably not installed; paper is a later disjoint window where it is installed and acts; ORDER becomes Historical, Simulated, Shadow, Paper.
A committed phase register lists each phase's exit capability and named tests, and an acceptance test refuses a phase entered over an unexited predecessor; no runtime feature flags.
A GcsLeaseStore implements LeaseStore over one object whose generation is the version, in a regional bucket created with the nodes; no Spanner instance for a lock.

Cross-region mirroring is decided: an in-tree asynchronous fabric-mirror consumer (ADR 0119, accepted 2026-10-11); the rows' 'C8 refuses mirroring' text is stale and what is left is the build and a second region to deploy into.
The metadata quorum is decided: Spanner under lease-epoch checks, three brokers one per zone, openraft not taken (ADR 0111 Amendment 1).
Attested operator presence is decided (ADR 0120, per-person WebAuthn keys); the row's 'write ADR 0121' is stale and the code slice is left.
Admit a Postgres wire client (crate or in-tree) and an AlloyDB instance for workflow metadata, reversing ADR 0113's refusal of AlloyDB.
decisions.enables: AlloyDB adapter behind StorageTarget::AlloyDb and workflow state off the journal.
decisions.costs: A new crate or an in-tree wire protocol plus TLS; an AlloyDB cluster billed per vCPU-hour from creation.

decisions.statement: Admit Bigtable, Spanner Graph, BigQuery and Knowledge Catalog as stores (ADR 0113 admitted Spanner for the ledger only).
decisions.enables: Graph store of promoted entities, hot feature store, evidence reads through the fabric.
decisions.costs: Each is billed infrastructure enabled in the project; REST adapters are in-tree work under ADR 0113 §2.

decisions.statement: Decide the licence for each alternative-data provider (satellite, AIS, flight, port, traffic, commodity, energy grid, IoT) under ADR 0034.
decisions.enables: Seven connector modules join connector_feed.rs dispatch.
decisions.costs: Vendor contracts and fees, and an external account per provider.

decisions.statement: Enable accelerators (Vertex AI GPU/TPU) and decide whether they reach qip-optimization-engine's Substrate dispatch; ADR 0122 confines accelerators to the offline research lane.
decisions.enables: Gpu/Tpu substrate arms, measured workload fit, larger model families.
decisions.costs: Vertex AI enablement and accelerator hours; reopening ADR 0122's 'accelerators only here'; a model dependency if a family is not written in-tree.

decisions.statement: Admit a hosted large model as a foundry candidate through qip-deepbrain's language gateway.
decisions.enables: A large-model candidate class under the same promotion ladder.
decisions.costs: A provider credential and per-token spend through the gateway.

decisions.statement: Admit IBM QPU hardware: account, credential, egress route and budget.
decisions.enables: Hosted admission in compute_routing.rs::from_lookup.
decisions.costs: An external account, a credential, per-job QPU spend.

decisions.statement: Admit a QUIC crate under ADR 0109, after ADR 0112 §4's committed cross-region TCP+TLS versus QUIC measurement.
decisions.enables: QUIC for the fabric hop and the peer link.
decisions.costs: A new transport crate and its closure; the measurement needs a second region.

decisions.statement: Admit prost/protobuf codegen for generated fabric bindings.
decisions.enables: Versioned Protobuf descriptors and generated types.
decisions.costs: A codegen dependency and build-time tool on the allow-list.

decisions.statement: Admit an OpenTelemetry exporter crate and tokio on the fabric SDK path.
decisions.enables: Async subscriptions and OTel hooks in the SDK.
decisions.costs: A new exporter crate; tokio moves closer to the cell than ADR 0109 Amendment 2 allows without a measurement.

decisions.statement: Admit blake3 for the fabric content hash.
decisions.enables: The Blake3 codec arm (SHA-256 today).
decisions.costs: One crate on the allow-list; two hashes in the codec.

decisions.statement: Raise P2/P3 replication above RF1 (ADR 0111 §2 waits on a measurement).
decisions.enables: RF2/3 for P2/P3, tiered retention, throttled mirroring.
decisions.costs: Spanner or Managed Kafka capacity for bulk classes.

decisions.statement: Admit an SMT/MILP solver crate (Z3 refused by ADR 0099 C5).
decisions.enables: SMT theories and MILP in constraint.rs.
decisions.costs: A large native dependency or a long in-tree solver.

decisions.statement: Admit libc for mlockall/busy-poll and a local-SSD machine shape.
decisions.enables: Memory locking and busy polling on the node.
decisions.costs: libc on the allow-list (syscall surface under unsafe_code=forbid); local SSD billing.

decisions.statement: Admit a real venue connection, even market-data-only (ADR 0003/0021).
decisions.enables: Native venue feeds into the reflex node.
decisions.costs: A venue licence, credential and account; the paper boundary's feed half changes.

decisions.statement: Enable quoting on the simulated venue: lift quote_loop.rs's no-path-to-an-order and the node ModeGate's quoting refusal.
decisions.enables: Quotes placed on the simulator, an edge quote engine, market-making reservations.
decisions.costs: The most dangerous composition in the tree, by its own module doc; quoting is order submission at every real venue.

decisions.statement: Reopen ADR 0114 D8 for an outbound channel or external action surface.
decisions.enables: A real channel behind ConductGate, surveys, public adapters.
decisions.costs: A public channel, its credential and account, and reputational exposure.

decisions.statement: Split scouts and engineering into their own projects before the second region (ADR 0113 §4, ADR 0118).
decisions.enables: Project-level isolation for scouts and engineering.
decisions.costs: More projects, budgets and IAM; ADR 0118 bootstrap re-run.

decisions.statement: Give agent sessions their own identity (a Workload Identity pool) and scoped per-run credentials.
decisions.enables: A principal that distinguishes an agent from a person; sandboxed credentials.
decisions.costs: New IAM pool and providers; issuing credentials to agents.

decisions.statement: Choose the provenance producer: a pinned third-party action or a gcloud-only SLSA statement.
decisions.enables: SLSA provenance attached to every pushed image.
decisions.costs: A third-party action in the supply chain, or in-tree statement generation; deploy.yml is a protected path.

decisions.statement: Reopen prod reconciliation from Git (ADR 0036/0093).
decisions.enables: Production reconciled by the control plane.
decisions.costs: Reopens prod promotion, which the deploy gate and gitops.rs refuse.

decisions.statement: Admit automatic rollback on Cloud Run (ADR 0114 refuses Argo Rollouts).
decisions.enables: release_decision driving a rollback and an incident.
decisions.costs: A controller acting on production traffic without a person.

decisions.statement: Admit libfuzzer-sys and a nightly toolchain for a PR fuzz job.
decisions.enables: cargo-fuzz targets in CI.
decisions.costs: A crate and a second toolchain; CI minutes.

decisions.statement: Enable passkeys on the Identity Platform tenant: raise the provider pin or set it in the console and record it.
decisions.enables: Passkeys for operators.
decisions.costs: A provider pin change or a manual tenant change outside Terraform.

decisions.statement: Split cognitive services or the strategic lattice into separately deployed Cloud Run services (ADR 0024 catalogue).
decisions.enables: Independent scaling and a strategic service whose outage only backs up research.
decisions.costs: More services, images, identities and minimum instances.

decisions.statement: Admit Vertex AI Agent Engine as a second agent runtime.
decisions.enables: Managed agent sessions and memory.
decisions.costs: A managed paid runtime and a contract change to AgentManifest.

decisions.statement: An ambient draft has no identified effect, so the unidentified effect is recorded and acts on nothing: the deep brain's ambient draft learns a measured, unidentified effect (NotIdentified, identifiability 0) and that effect acts on nothing: Federation::update_from_attribution refuses an unidentified attribution, the memory's recommendation ignores zero-confidence records, the causal graph gets no update operation, drafting is not gated on it, and the platform assigns no treatment, writes no per-opportunity model and runs the guard not engine::run. Revived only by a control an ADR amending 0114 authorises plus a consumer.

The ambient agency door drafts under one identity, is a registered brain and not an organisation agent, and its assertions are the claims its citations carry: the ambient agency door drafts under one acting identity (structurally vacuous clause, no second-identity seam), authority above Shadow is unreachable not pending, the causal-agency BrainSpec is its registration with no organisation agent and no coverage scope, and conduct is judged by a structured claim rule: an assertion is a citation's claim checked against records, prose is not parsed. Revocation becomes durable with a declared-operator reauthorisation record; a goal carries no authority class; no order-path conduct refusal is decided.

The panel sees the book: risk and book views are rebuilt once per convened panel from the platform's own state, and a control's finding withholds a thesis and is never evidence: The desk's RiskView and BookView become Upstreams written once per convened panel from risk_state() and the book at cost, journaled with the cycle. The code showed there is no veto: a Control's Negative finding is read by stance_of against the claim's sign and would support a bearish thesis, so control findings leave the evidence set and a blocking limit instead withholds a thesis that adds to the exposure it protects. No capital agent, no meta-arbiter, no symbolic agent; two context-only probes, a private-holdings view and the approved_conviction writer are decided.

A counterfactual has one reference: a missed opportunity is scored as a claim in basis points and never priced at a side nobody proposed, and every alternative is a named arm of the twin's menu: A counterfactual is a difference against a reference somebody proposed. A missed opportunity is already graded as a claim in basis points (prediction, episode, realised_move_bps); it is never priced in money, and the ungradeable remainder is a counted series. Hedged and unwound paths are the twin's existing NoHedge and DoNotTrade arms, labelled by an ExposureEffect; FillScore gains an attributed model set; the four-way split stamps three read-off quantities; shadows stay the twin's arms; models are re-verified on a cycle count and demoted through the existing rollback path.

A model reaches a cell only through the signed release path, a challenger meets one perturbation rule and one forecaster contract, and an added field never moves a digest: The contract ModelPack is the only record that names a model to a cell and is not split: the kernel already admits signed packs, and the missing step is an unsigned draft plus a qip-cli signing subcommand. Promotion runs a decision-flip perturbation suite that measures before it refuses, and a stress claim needs the baseline validated in that regime. A tournament entrant must be a function that exists,: unmetered is absent, not zero. Retired strategies compact to tombstones; an added field enters a digest only when present.

Solver scope is the portfolio QUBO and the bounded in-tree constraint solver; no other quantum family without a measured benefit, no neural coupling, no solver crate: The portfolio QUBO is the only quantum family; a new family needs a stated benefit case (instances above the exact-enumeration limit and within the qubit ceiling) and no default-path problem is invented to switch the arm on. No quantum-informed producer, no quantum features, no QUBO for continuous problems. Symbolic scope: neural coupling out, reasoning in-process with `qip replay` as the checker, settlement stays a calendar-day lower bound, no SAT/SMT/MILP crate (dissent recorded). A conclusion with no journaled derivation forms no proposal; contested theses stay small, not blocked.

What enters UNDERSTAND: consumer first: MarketStatePack is a downgrade-only integrity annotation built over drained events; a fused posterior may only narrow REASON; FutureTree is not grown in SIMULATE; the sealed outcome record gains no field; flow, event and raw-frame inputs wait for licensed sources

Evidence and memory journals: admitted claims journal on a new evidence.admitted topic (DerivedState) and links, contests and resolutions are derived by replay; source specs get source.registered; a full all-contested fabric refuses; a new source is zero-weight until promoted; an episode is a resolved outcome

The ledger books only facts a producer observed: a commitment books once at assembly from the universe record on the existing ledger.operation_recorded topic (Commit only); a user mandate funding is a MandateSubscription; assumed margin, Hedged, cycle kinds and tax never book; an open commerce break holds its unit

The arbitrage desk trades only the operator's whitelist, sequentially: the whitelist is the permission (no central discovery, no concurrent legs); production markets must state costs and the centre may only lower a stated fill probability from measured fills; own-cell cycles keep zero coordination latency; rebalancing moves into qip-peer; the Lane 1 frame stays an epoch

The cell admits against declared inputs, an edge nobody computed gates nothing, a belief never enlarges a size, and operating eligibility is one fail-closed register: Every control the cell admits against reads a declared input whose absence is a stated refusal or a stated absence of the control. Product class is the asset class, the regulated function is the order's execution mode, and leverage has one measure. A signal states an expected edge only if its rule declares one, and the net-edge gate is unarmed without a margin. No cell reads a belief value. Deployment identity is a signed set; operating eligibility is the compliance register, with a paper-only seed.

Platform plumbing is restated to the accepted records: schema descriptors, archive format, storage classes and the telemetry drain have one home each: Reconciles ADRs 0100, 0109, 0111, 0112, 0113, 0118, 0119 and 0135, then gives each plumbing seam one home. The committed schema lock supplies descriptors and the broker admits by topic and version. Archive objects are never merged and a per-batch digest waits on a measurement. A declared storage-class list guards store construction. One services crate hosts the OTLP drain. QUIC, five brokers, mirror and mesh-compression requirements are restated; no hub, bucket, collector or prod broker is decided.

A source enters only as a committed licence record that quotes the terms it was read from, a descriptor never polls, and vendor choice is billed: A source is read only through a licence record in qip-data-finder's catalogue that quotes the terms document, date, reader and clause it was read from and carries its cost; a charging source also needs a named owner approval. Five earlier entries are held by a ratchet that may only shrink. A descriptor never polls, no crawl builds candidates, reserved-domain placeholders cannot hold a declared licence, claim coordinates come from the publisher's payload or are absent, and the price of information has a form but no value. Vendors are the owner's.

A grant changes a named budget or is not made, a specialist proposal is a gap and not an agent, and fetched content is untrusted by type until validated: A compute grant lands on one of four named budgets (a resource budget, a per-agent compute ceiling, the desk's start gate, the sweep's acquisition budget) or the bid is not made; no grant raises a ceiling, moves a learning cadence or queues a solver, and the TPU budget stays zero. A class's exposure is gross, at cost and exclusively attributed or counted unattributed; a specialist proposal is a gap. The federation's request is canonical, and fetched content is Untrusted<T> until a validator narrows it.

Capital has one floor, one declared shelf and one declared withdrawal notice, and a forecast may only narrow a release, never the worlds a hedge survives: The book's floor is what the survival waterfall withholds, stated once; CapitalBook gets no kernel caller. The yield shelf is an operator declaration in a committed file, the router takes an idle amount derived from the waterfall and holds it in the reservation ledger, and a withdrawal signal is a dated operator notice that moves nothing and only refuses placements. A calibrated forecast may only add worlds, never shrink the set a hedge must survive; the forecast contract states what it cannot measure.

Licensed trade tape with aggressor side [ADR 0151]; Licensed event-resolution source [ADR 0151]; Licence permitting raw frame retention [ADR 0151]; Vendor-supplied option/future/FX sensitivities or price feeds for the classes RISK-4107 leaves out [ADR 0155]; NCC hub, spokes and data transfer [ADR 0156]; Prod event_fabric_broker instances and any count above three per region [ADR 0156]; enable_cloud_storage buckets [ADR 0156]; OTLP collector (vendored or hosted), its egress listener and ingestion [ADR 0156]; CA Service template and per-certificate issuance for operator certificates [ADR 0156]; Mirror host in a second region [ADR 0156]; Choosing, contracting or paying any data vendor or licence: licensed exchange feeds and depth, court/procurement/patent/registry products, social and news vendors, commerce data, satellite/IoT/shipping/customs, options/futures/funding/liquidation feeds, logistics, geopolitical and guidance/capital-structure series [ADR 0157]; The owner approval record a charging source's licence entry must name, and any declared value_per_ic_month that could make a paid source selectable [ADR 0157]; The research-campaign data-spend cap value and acquisition_budget_bp in any deployment [ADR 0157]; Whether automated crawling of a given publisher is lawful, and the owner's back-fill of read_on/read_by for the five grandfathered sources [ADR 0157]; Any TPU or other accelerator budget (the Tpu entry in run_market stays the literal zero) [ADR 0158]; Default queue quota values for a billed training provider (Vertex) [ADR 0158]; Values of compute_per_sweep, qpu_per_sweep and acquisition_budget_bp in any deployment [ADR 0158]; Custodian statement feed or licensed yield-shelf data source [ADR 0159]

decisions.statement: Listed, not decided (RISK): A conduct gate or conduct rule on the order path (kernel ACT, execution engine): structure, phrases, thresholds, fault behaviour [ADR 0146]; Whether withholding a thesis under a blocking, applicable, existing limit (decision 5) is itself a 'conduct bound that refuses'. It applies installed limits with no new number and refuses a thesis, not an order, but the owner may read it as a risk matter. [ADR 0147]; The capacity of the bounded own-activity window (PROPOSAL_HISTORY fills) for the self-exploitation probe. [ADR 0147]; A declared reference size for a money-priced missed opportunity (the Dissent's revival condition). [ADR 0148]; Any change to the sizing-cap sample (COUNTERFACTUAL_SIZING_MIN_SAMPLE, the unfavourable fraction, the halved cap) or separating reducing fills from it. [ADR 0148]; Values of the perturbation fraction, the flip-share ceiling and MAX_LIVE_STRATEGIES (structure and initial constants decided as model-acceptance and working-set parameters, not exposure caps) [ADR 0149]; Multiplier value narrowing a hypothesis whose symbolic derivation has a refused part [ADR 0150]; Whether the default Mandate.maximum_holdings stops being None [ADR 0150]; Health-multiplier values and any floor under the fused-posterior multiplier [ADR 0151]; Fill-probability sample floor and confidence, and any concurrent-leg arm [ADR 0154]; Authority-bound values per grant (max_leverage, permitted product classes), net-edge margin and whether edgeless signals are refused, requote-layering window/minimum/ratio, credential lead window, any belief narrowing schedule [ADR 0155]; Simulated chain finality depth for a decentralised venue's settlement [ADR 0155]; Survival fractions and any change; maximum share of unreleased capital routed; shelf capacities and realisations; whether a declared notice raises the funding tier or emergency reserve; minimum resolved-forecast count; custody-statement freshness thresholds; any reserve increase caused by a forecast-derived world [ADR 0159]
